flowchart LR
  alert([Alert raised]) --> triage{Known issue?}
  triage -->|yes| runbook[Run the runbook]
  triage -->|no| owner[Page the service owner]
  runbook --> verify[Verify recovery]
  owner --> fix[Ship a fix]
  fix --> verify
  verify --> close((Close))
bootNote: The engine is about 3 MB and is cached after the first visit. Rendering happens in your browser; nothing you type is sent anywhere.
notes: This page runs the ChartForgeX 2.0 NuGet packages compiled to WebAssembly. The SVG you see is the same output a .NET application gets from the snippet beside this note.
ChartForgeX markup is Markdown with chartforgex fences. Mermaid fences inside a markup document render too, so one document can hold charts, tables, flows and diagrams.
ZenUML, Agentflow and Railroad diagrams are recognised and reported, but not rendered yet.
